countScope: Read-only pre-initialization inspection; later G1 outputs are also ignored.
prospectiveRules: Real environment files and common key/token/private-key files
Virtual environments, installed packages and caches
Editor/machine files and temporary build/test output
privateResearchPolicy: README, CODEX_HANDOFF and Sprint 3 report designate real geometry/raw captures as private; they remain ignored.
thirdPartyCopies: Local Mapbox terms PDF and extracted text remain intact outside the baseline; redistribution rights were not established. Existing documentation retains official URLs.
evidencePolicy: No blanket artifacts/ or log exclusion. Reviewed historical logs, JUnit, summaries, synthetic receipts and aggregate map coverage queries/results are included. Disposable clean-install copies are excluded; canonical source/locks and public summaries remain included.
rejectedHistoryPolicy: Rejected implementation source is absent. Its old design reports, validation receipts and redacted logs are retained as historical evidence; the rollback reports establish rejection and removal.
